She takes care of your little four-legged friend with care and love.
A reliable and highly professional doctor.
The doctor is an angel, she's doing ozone therapy on Thor and the results are already visible. It's a shame I didn't know her sooner.

An extraordinary professional! Dr. Gilda took care of my dog ​​when he was a puppy, and I never left her side, even when I moved out of the region. And now, I've been following her for almost 12 years, including through online consultations. Gilda has always been there during even the most difficult times, providing emotional support and sound advice, even answering questions on Sundays! Furthermore, how could you not trust someone who, despite her many years of experience, continues to update her skills and study new therapeutic approaches. She works by considering each furry friend from a 360° perspective, including behavioral and emotional aspects. This is my—and our—certainty! Thank you, Doctor!

A bitter and unpleasant experience
Besides speculating, the doctor doesn't know how to read diagnostic tests.
Unfortunately, I went to her for my dog's cervical hernia, bringing along a DICOM and a complete report with images. With incredible confidence, she immediately and consistently reassured us that the ozone therapy she performed would be 100% effective and that the dog absolutely did not need surgery. After 15 sessions, suffering for the dog, wasting time and money (€50 per session without a receipt), with the doctor constantly saying that it was impossible for her not to improve and insinuating that perhaps another hernia had emerged, we were forced to have a second MRI just to confirm that the hernia was still the one that had increased in size and that already from the first MRI it was clear that it needed to be removed only surgically.

An excellent professional, expert and meticulous, but above all passionate about her work and attentive to the needs of us animals. She treated me with the same kindness that my human always gives me. :) I'm only a year old, but it's been my best veterinary experience so far. Thank you and best regards, Peppina. Velia
